description: This Java class defines the OrderContext which encapsulates contextual information for Orders within the OpenMRS healthcare system, including order type, care setting, and custom attributes. It provides getter and setter methods for these fields and manages a map of additional context attributes.

classes.name: OrderContext
classes.description: Represents contextual information related to Orders, such as order type, care setting, and custom attributes. Used when placing orders in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getCareSetting
methods.description: Returns the care setting associated with the order.

methods.name: getContextAttributes
methods.description: Returns the map of custom context attributes, initializing it if null.

methods.name: setContextAttributes
methods.description: Sets the map of context attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific attribute by name.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Adds or updates a specific context attribute.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a specific attribute by name.
